plan.title: PR Hold and ERP Send-Back RBAC

steps.note: Reaches the Purchase Requisitions area, the closest catalog-supported screen for the requested PR actions.

args.need: sign in as the user without the Buyer role on the specified Enterprise tenant, attempt PR Hold and ERP Send-Back on an ambiguous PR line, then repeat both actions as a Buyer and report whether each action is refused, absent, or available and whether tenant RBAC intentionally grants it to other roles

steps.note: The catalog has no step for these PR actions or for switching between the two required user roles.
